reference_sql: SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS procedimento, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos FROM internacoes i JOIN internacao_procedimento ip ON i."N_AIH" = ip."N_AIH" JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2021 AND (i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'E10%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'E11%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'E12%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'E13%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'E14%') AND p."NOME_PROC" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."NOME_PROC") <> '' AND p."NOME_PROC" NOT IN ('Nao preenchido', 'Nao informado') GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS procedimento, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos FROM internacoes i JOIN internacao_procedimento ip ON i."N_AIH" = ip."N_AIH" JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2021 AND (i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J12%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J13%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J14%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J15%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J16%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J17%' OR i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J18%') AND p."NOME_PROC" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."NOME_PROC") <> '' AND p."NOME_PROC" NOT IN ('Nao preenchido', 'Nao informado') GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC LIMIT 10;
